newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: S&P assigns Tranz Rail BBB plus rating.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns Tranz Rail BBB plus rating.

text.p: Standard and Poor's said on Tuesday it had assigned Tranz Rail Holdings Ltd a BBB plus long term credit rating and said the company's outlook was stable.
S&P also said Tranz Rail's operating profit should improve.
The rating also applied to Tranz Rail Finance Ltd's proposed US$74 million 144A pass-through certificates.

Each pass-through certificate will represent a fractional undivided interest in equipment notes, which have security over specific lease-financed rail equipment currently part of the Tranz Rail fleet.
"Looking forward, operating profit should improve, based on expected growth in the domestic economy and the expansion of international trade," S&P said.

There were opportunities for the company in Australia to participate in the privatisation process, but it was likely to preserve its sound financial profile by funding any acquisition with a combination of debt and equity.
The company's policy was to operate within a net debt to capital range of 35-45 percent.
Tranz Rail is 22.7 percent owned by Wisconsin Central Transportation Corp.
